meta.description: Meet the faculty from Kota who teach our JEE programme in Pune: their subjects, their years of teaching and where in Kota they taught.

intro.text: Experienced faculty from Kota teach our JEE programme, here in Pune.

sections.heading: Meet the faculty
body: Each profile gives the teacher's subject, their years of teaching and where they taught in Kota.

sections.heading: What a Kota teacher brings
body: A teacher from Kota has taught the JEE syllabus to batch after batch, on a fixed calendar of tests. That shows in the small things: which chapter needs an extra week, which mistakes turn up on a mock, and when a class needs to slow down.

body.text: Here, that teaching comes with one-on-one mentoring slots, so your child can take a hard problem to the teacher directly.
